The separate coupon is only a test print.","questions":[{"text":"How did the previous 7.60 mm retaining throat fit?","answer":"Could not report the result for either print."}],"params":{"nut_af":{"value":8,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog","note":"ISO 4032 M5 across flats; actual nut not measured"},"nut_h":{"value":4.7,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog"},"bolt_d":{"value":5,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog"},"bolt_clearance":{"value":0.6,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"knob_d":{"value":30,"kind":"design","source":"asked"},"floor_t":{"value":3,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"pocket_af_clearance":{"value":0.5,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"Main hex pocket is nut_af plus this value"},"nut_axial_play":{"value":0.5,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"finger_t":{"value":0.8,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"finger_w":{"value":3.2,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"finger_back_gap":{"value":1,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"finger_side_gap":{"value":0.6,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"lip_intrusion":{"value":0.45,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"Each finger protrudes this far into pocket; throat = nut_af + pocket_af_clearance - 2*lip_intrusion = 7.60 mm"},"lip_band_h":{"value":0.4,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"lead_h":{"value":1.4,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"lip_overlap":{"value":0.08,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"grip_count":{"value":8,"unit":"count","kind":"design","source":"design"},"grip_cut_r":{"value":2,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"grip_cut_offset":{"value":15.5,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"coupon_d":{"value":18,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"cut_extra":{"value":0.5,"kind":"design","source":"design"}},"parts":[{"id":"knob","role":"final","material":"PLA","code":"import math

def build(p):
    a=(p.nut_af+p.pocket_af_clearance)/2
    zl=p.floor_t+p.nut_h+p.nut_axial_play
    H=zl+p.lip_band_h+p.lead_h
    out=cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.knob_d/2).extrude(H)
    for i in range(int(p.grip_count)):
        t=2*math.pi*i/p.grip_count
        out=out.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').center(p.grip_cut_offset*math.cos(t),p.grip_cut_offset*math.sin(t)).circle(p.grip_cut_r).extrude(H+p.cut_extra))
    v=[(a,a/math.sqrt(3)),(0,2*a/math.sqrt(3)),(-a,a/math.sqrt(3)),(-a,-a/math.sqrt(3)),(0,-2*a/math.sqrt(3)),(a,-a/math.sqrt(3))]
    out=out.cut(cq.Workplane('XY',origin=(0,0,p.floor_t)).polyline(v).close().extrude(H-p.floor_t+p.cut_extra))
    out=out.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').circle((p.bolt_d+p.bolt_clearance)/2).extrude(H+p.cut_extra))
    for s in (-1,1):
        out=out.cut(cq.Workplane('XY',origin=(s*(a+p.finger_t+p.finger_back_gap/2),0,p.floor_t)).box(p.finger_back_gap,p.finger_w+2*p.finger_side_gap,H-p.floor_t+p.cut_extra,centered=(True,True,False)))
        lo=a-p.lip_intrusion-p.cut_extra
        hi=a+p.finger_t+p.finger_back_gap
        for side in (-1,1):
            out=out.cut(cq.Workplane('XY',origin=(s*(lo+hi)/2,side*(p.finger_w/2+p.finger_side_gap/2),p.floor_t)).box(hi-lo,p.finger_side_gap,H-p.floor_t+p.cut_extra,centered=(True,True,False)))
        pts=[(s*(a-p.lip_intrusion),zl),(s*(a+p.lip_overlap),zl),(s*(a+p.lip_overlap),H),(s*a,H),(s*(a-p.lip_intrusion),zl+p.lip_band_h)]
        out=out.union(cq.Workplane('XZ').polyline(pts).close().extrude(p.finger_w).translate((0,p.finger_w/2,0)))
    return out
